scope: Baseline main release audit before subsequent README, slide and comparison updates; not an audit of future commits.

main_ci.interpretation: Integration observations, not the historical Berkeley matrix or a reliability estimate. No new paid inference was performed for this audit.

secrets_scan.archive_checksum_verification: Matched the official release checksums file before execution.
secrets_scan.common_options: GITLEAKS_CONFIG and GITLEAKS_CONFIG_TOML unset; no repository configuration; empty ignore directory; --redact=100 --ignore-gitleaks-allow --no-banner --no-color --timeout=120 --report-format=json

tracked_export.method: git archive at the audited revision, then gitleaks dir EXPORT --max-archive-depth=3

remaining_formal_release_items: Review and validate the final candidate, including new evaluation artifacts.
Independently verify the signed-in non-collaborator New issue flow recorded in issue 85.
